# <span id="aanchor312"></span> Review Test Report

This functionality is only available with TESTit integration.

Users can apply edits or PPAs to data using TESTit test reports. These adjustments can be applied automatically upon import of a test report, or manually through the Review Test Report screen.

PPAs must be allowed in order to make calibration adjustments on open data from a test report. PPAs via Test Reports must be enabled for auto calibration adjustments on closed data.

<div class="procedure">

To manually apply data from a TESTit test report:

1.  Go to **Review** \> **Review Test Report**.

2.  Select a list, location, or meter to view imported test reports for.

3.  Select a time filter to locate the desired test reports.

    When the "Use Date Range" option is enabled, the "From" date defaults to one month prior to the current date; this can be set to any date range.

    You can also select a status filter when looking for a specific test report or perform a full text search to locate a test summary.

    A list of test summaries created from TESTit test reports that match the filter criteria will display.

4.  If you need to change the From or To date or the Error Tolerance or Min Unit Difference, then select a row and click the **Edit** button. Click **Save** to save your edits.

5.  If you want to bypass the error tolerance and minimum unit difference checks and calculate a calibration adjustment anyway, enable the "Force" option on the applicable rows.

6.  To preview the results of the calibration adjustment before actually applying and saving the results, click the **Preview** button. (See: <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Calibration Adjustment Preview">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Calibration Adjustment Preview</a>)

7.  Select the rows on which you want to apply the calibration adjustment and click **Apply**.

Double-click a row to view an individual test report. If TESTit 3 Integration is enabled, the task report PDF will display in your PDF reader.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" />

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Details">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Screen Details</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Details">

The following columns are available on the Review Test Report screen:

- **Meter Number**
- **Test Date** - The date the test was performed
- **Status**
  - **Applied** - Test report was applied and an edit or PPA was made (actual edit may not have been made)
  - **Not Applied** - Test report not been applied yet
  - **Failed** - Test report failed to apply
  - **Partial** - Test report did not successfully apply to the specified time frame
  - **Attempted** - Test report port was applied but no adjustment was necessary based on tolerance set
- **From/To Date** - Defines the span for which the test report will be applied
- **Error Tolerance** - Limit
- **Minimum Unit Difference** - Low limit
- **Force** - Temporarily sets error tolerance and minimum unit difference to values that will force the adjustment, effectively bypassing error tolerance and minimum unit difference checks

</div>

<span id="AdjustmentPreview"></span><a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Calibration Adjustment Preview">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Calibration Adjustment Preview</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Calibration Adjustment Preview">

Users can preview calibration adjustments without saving the results. The preview function executes the calibration adjustment process and displays the corresponding results. When the preview screen is dismissed, the results are discarded and no edits or PPAs are created.

The Preview button is only enabled when a single test report is selected and its status is "Not Applied", "Failed", or "Partial".

The Preview button is a multi-function "split" button, which provides a default action (the main portion of the button labeled Preview), or a drop-down selection of actions (the down arrowhead on the right side of the button). For this button, the default and selectable actions determine the layout of the preview screen.

The drop-down options are "Compact" and "Detailed". The default action is determined via the "Show Individual Transmitter Corrections" TESTit option (Settings \> TESTit Integration Configuration \> Test Report Preview).

The **compact layout** provides a view of volume, energy, and mass adjustments. The current value, revised (new) value, percent difference, and unit difference are shown for each quantity. Other columns indicate whether a PPA will be created and display a notation of errors encountered that may prevent successful adjustment when the test report is applied. Each month that will be affected by the adjustment is shown separately.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 740;height: 391;" />

The **detailed layout** adds the individual impact of each transmitter on the volume. The percent differences and unit differences are shown.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 656;height: 429;" />

</div>
